defects.catch_criteria: In tests/unit/orchestration/app-service/project-state-channel.test.ts, the test "relays the Worker's response unread" cannot detect a relay that decodes and re-encodes the body: its byte-equality case uses a body made by the same canonical encoder, which a decode and re-encode reproduces byte for byte, and its "unreadable" body is valid MessagePack that only fails schema validation. A catch must say that the test still passes if readdressProjectStateResponse (or the account relay) unpacks and repacks the body, and so does not prove the no-decode claim; naming a non-canonical or non-MessagePack body as the missing case also counts.
defects.title: The unread-relay test passes with body decode and re-encode restored
